lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕੋਟਿ ਦੋਖ ਰੋਗਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤੁਹਾਰੀ ਹਾਤੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahaa kilabikh kot dokh rogaa prabh drisat tuhaaree haate ||
lines.translation: The greatest sins, and millions of pains and diseases are destroyed by Your Gracious Glance, O God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋਵਤ ਜਾਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਇਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਪਰਾਤੇ ॥੨॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: sovat jaag har har har gaaiaa naanak gur charan paraate ||2||8||
lines.translation: While sleeping and waking, Nanak sings the Lord's Name, Har, Har, Har; he falls at the Guru's feet. ||2||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree 5 ||
lines.translation: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਿਓ ਨੈਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: so prabh jat kat pekhio nainee ||
lines.translation: I have seen that God with my eyes everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਬੈਣੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukhadaaee jeean ko daataa a(n)mrit jaa kee bainee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: The Giver of peace, the Giver of souls, His Speech is Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਧੇਰਾ ਸੰਤੀ ਕਾਟਿਆ ਜੀਅ ਦਾਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਦੈਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: agiaan adheraa sa(n)tee kaatiaa jee daan gur dainee ||
lines.translation: The Saints dispel the darkness of ignorance; the Guru is the Giver of the gift of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਜਲਤੇ ਸੀਤਲ ਹੋਣੀ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa kar leeno apunaa jalate seetal honee ||1||
lines.translation: Granting His Grace, the Lord has made me His own; I was on fire, but now I am cooled. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਮੁ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਉਪਜਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਨਹ ਉਪਜੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਕਰਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: karam dharam kichh upaj na aaio nah upajee niramal karanee ||
lines.translation: The karma of good deeds, and the Dharma of righteous faith, have not been produced in me, in the least; nor has pure conduct welled up in me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਛਾਡਿ ਸਿਆਨਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਗੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ॥੨॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: chhaad siaanap sa(n)jam naanak laago gur kee charanee ||2||9||
lines.translation: Renouncing cleverness and self-mortification, O Nanak, I fall at the Guru's feet. ||2||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree 5 ||
lines.translation: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਲਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har raam naam jap laahaa ||
lines.translation: Chant the Lord's Name, and earn the profit.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਕਾਟੇ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਫਾਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gat paavahi sukh sahaj ana(n)daa kaate jam ke phaahaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You shall attain salvation, peace, poise and bliss, and the noose of Death shall be cut away. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਤ ਖੋਜਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਪਹਿ ਆਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: khojat khojat khoj beechaario har sa(n)t janaa pahi aahaa ||
lines.translation: Searching, searching, searching and reflecting, I have found that the Lord's Name is with the Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨੑਾ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਏਹੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਲਿਖਾਹਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tinhaa paraapat ehu nidhaanaa jinh kai karam likhaahaa ||1||
lines.translation: They alone obtain this treasure, who have such pre-ordained destiny. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਬਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੇ ਪਤਿਵੰਤੇ ਸੇਈ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: se badabhaagee se pativa(n)te seee poore saahaa ||
lines.translation: They are very fortunate and honorable; they are the perfect bankers.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁੰਦਰ ਸੁਘੜ ਸਰੂਪ ਤੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਹਾ ॥੨॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: su(n)dar sughaR saroop te naanak jinh har har naam visaahaa ||2||10||
lines.translation: They are beautiful, so very wise and handsome; O Nanak, purchase the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||2||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree 5 ||
lines.translation: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਕਹ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਅਫਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man kah aha(n)kaar aphaaraa ||
lines.translation: O mind, why are you so puffed up with egotism?

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਅਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਅਪਾਵਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜੋ ਦੀਸੈ ਸੋ ਛਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: duraga(n)dh apavitr apaavan bheetar jo deesai so chhaaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Whatever is seen in this foul, impure and filthy world, is only ashes. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕੀਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪਰਾਨੀ ਜੀਉ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਜਿਨਿ ਧਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin keeaa tis simar paraanee jeeu praan jin dhaaraa ||
lines.translation: Remember the One who created you, O mortal; He is the Support of your soul, and the breath of life.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਵਰ ਲਪਟਾਵਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਨਮਹਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tisahi tiaag avar lapataavahi mar janamahi mugadh gavaaraa ||1||
lines.translation: One who forsakes Him, and attaches himself to another, dies to be reborn; he is such an ignorant fool! ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਗੁੰਗ ਪਿੰਗੁਲ ਮਤਿ ਹੀਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dh gu(n)g pi(n)gul mat heenaa prabh raakhahu raakhanahaaraa ||
lines.translation: I am blind, mute, crippled and totally lacking in understanding; O God, Preserver of all, please preserve me!

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰ ਸਮਰਥਾ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਜੰਤ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: karan karaavanahaar samarathaa kiaa naanak ja(n)t bichaaraa ||2||11||
lines.translation: The Creator, the Cause of causes is all-powerful; O Nanak, how helpless are His beings! ||2||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree 5 ||
lines.translation: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇਰੈ ਹੂ ਤੇ ਨੇਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: so prabh nerai hoo te nerai ||
lines.translation: God is the nearest of the near.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਧਿਆਇ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਦਿਨੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਾਝ ਸਵੇਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: simar dhiaai gaai gun gobi(n)d din rain saajh saverai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Remember Him, meditate on Him, and sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, day and night, evening and morning. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਉਧਰੁ ਦੇਹ ਦੁਲਭ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੇਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: udhar deh dulabh saadhoo sa(n)g har har naam japerai ||
lines.translation: Redeem your body in the invaluable Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰੀ ਨ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨ ਚਸਾ ਬਿਲੰਬਹੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਨਿਤਹਿ ਨਿਤ ਹੇਰੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: gharee na muhat na chasaa bila(n)bahu kaal nitahi nit herai ||1||
lines.translation: Do not delay for an instant, even for a moment. Death is keeping you constantly in his vision. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਧ ਬਿਲਾ ਤੇ ਕਾਢਹੁ ਕਰਤੇ ਕਿਆ ਨਾਹੀ ਘਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dh bilaa te kaadhahu karate kiaa naahee ghar terai ||
lines.translation: Lift me up out of the dark dungeon, O Creator Lord; what is there which is not in Your home?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਆਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਘਨੇਰੈ ॥੨॥੧੨॥ ਛਕੇ ੨ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam adhaar deejai naanak kau aanad sookh ghanerai ||2||12|| chhake 2 ||
lines.translation: Bless Nanak with the Support of Your Name, that he may find great happiness and peace. ||2||12|| Second Set of Six||

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੇਵਗੰਧਾਰੀ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: devaga(n)dhaaree 5 ||
lines.translation: Dayv-Gandhaaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: man gur mil naam araadhio ||
lines.translation: O mind, meet with the Guru, and worship the Naam in adoration.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ ਜੀਵਨ ਕਾ ਮੂਲੁ ਬਾਧਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sookh sahaj aana(n)d ma(n)gal ras jeevan kaa mool baadhio ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: You shall obtain peace, poise, bliss, joy and pleasure, and lay the foundation of eternal life. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਕਾਟੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਫਾਧਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: kar kirapaa apunaa daas keeno kaate maaiaa phaadhio ||
lines.translation: Showing His Mercy, the Lord has made me His slave, and shattered the bonds of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿਦ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਸਾਧਿਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhaau bhagat gaai gun gobid jam kaa maarag saadhio ||1||
lines.translation: Through loving devotion, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, I have escaped the Path of Death. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਇਓ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਮੋਰਚਾ ਅਮੋਲ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਲਾਧਿਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaio anugrahu mitio morachaa amol padaarath laadhio ||
lines.translation: When he became Merciful, the rust was removed, and I found the priceless treasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਖ ਬੇਰਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿਓ ॥੨॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: balihaarai naanak lakh beraa mere thaakur agam agaadhio ||2||13||
lines.translation: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice, a hundred thousand times, to my unapproachable, unfathomable Lord and Master. ||2||13||
